@Image1 is Eamon: Elderly man, thin, weathered skin, grey hair cropped short, sharp jaw, kind blue eyes, wearing Heavy wool peacoat, dark blue sweater, worn leather boots; A brass compass on a chain around his neck, always glowing faintly. Keep this exact face, hair and outfit.
Each referenced person appears exactly once in frame.
The storm departs at dawn, leaving a glowing token on the gallery. Location: Lighthouse gallery, dawn, Dawn, calm sea.
[0s–8s] Hero looks at the horizon where the storm dissipates into soft clouds; dawn light breaks.
[8s–16s] Hero notices a smooth, glowing stone on the railing, left behind by the storm.
[16s–24s] Hero picks up the stone, smiles, and looks out to sea, compass still glowing.
Camera: Slow pull back, revealing the lighthouse in full, then crane down to hero's hand holding the stone, final wide shot of the calm sea.
Continuity: Dawn light, golden and pink, hero's coat dry, compass glowing faintly, stone gleams with a soft blue light.
Audio: Gentle waves, distant seagulls, soft piano motif, a single chime. No subtitles or on-screen text.
Style: Hand-drawn animation with watercolour textures, reminiscent of a graphic novel. Deep blues, teal, and warm amber light. Soft, diffused lighting with glowing edges. The lighthouse beam cuts through mist. Early 20th century, rustic, isolated. Non-photorealistic, painterly rendering.
